Sales Development Representative – United States

Location: United States (fully remote) Type: Full-time Compensation: $75,000–$90,000 USD per year

Pumpfiat is hiring a commercially minded, digitally experienced Sales Development Representative based in the United States. Use online sales, remote B2B sales, lead generation, and relationship-building to find business opportunities and help convert prospects into clients. This remote sales development opportunity pays $75,000–$90,000 USD per year, with 401(k), health insurance, and performance-based commission.

Apply for the US SDR role
← Back to all Pumpfiat careers

About the remote sales development role

As our US-based Sales Development Representative, you will identify potential customers, generate qualified leads, initiate conversations, present relevant services, and help convert prospects into clients. This role is broader than traditional cold calling: we value practical online selling, digital customer acquisition, and the ability to build trust and handle objections.

An existing social media audience or personal brand can help you reach customers, but a large following is not a requirement. Demonstrated sales ability, commercial awareness, audience relevance, and the ability to generate business matter more than raw follower count. This is a US-only position; applicants must be located in the United States.

What you’ll do

Sales development and lead generation

  • Identify and research potential customers and businesses in relevant markets.
  • Generate qualified leads through LinkedIn, social media, email outreach, online communities, and other digital channels.
  • Initiate meaningful business conversations, build a prospect pipeline, follow up consistently, and move qualified opportunities toward conversion.
  • Identify customer needs and assess whether Pumpfiat’s services are a suitable fit.

Online sales and customer acquisition

  • Apply your experience selling products or services online to attract customers and turn interest into purchasing decisions.
  • Use digital platforms, professional relationships, existing networks, and online communities to find business opportunities.
  • Develop creative approaches to online prospecting and customer acquisition; use a personal brand or audience where relevant.

Relationships, performance, and reporting

  • Build professional relationships, conduct initial discovery conversations, present services, and handle initial objections.
  • Coordinate with the internal team when prospects need additional technical or product information.
  • Keep accurate records, work toward agreed targets, track leads and conversions, and report pipeline activity and improvement ideas.

What you bring

  • Experience in sales, business development, digital sales, or customer acquisition, including practical experience selling products or services online.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, prospecting, follow-up, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence initiating conversations, understanding customer needs, and communicating solutions.
  • Experience using LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, or other digital platforms for business development.
  • Good organization, the ability to manage a sales pipeline, and independence in a fully remote role.
  • Residence in the United States, reliable internet access, and equipment needed to work remotely and communicate across time zones.

Helpful experience, not required

An engaged professional or entrepreneurial audience, social selling, e-commerce, selling digital products, consulting or software, affiliate or referral sales, partnerships, CRM systems, and sales automation can be useful. A social media following is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

Compensation and work arrangement

The annual salary range is $75,000–$90,000 USD. This full-time, fully remote role also includes a 401(k), health insurance, and performance-based commission. Applicants must be based in the United States.

Apply for the US Sales Development Representative role

Please apply only if you are currently based in the United States. Social profile links and audience details are optional.
